name: Native HTML (platform elements)
description: Elements and attributes built into the browser (dialog, popover, details, select, inputs, progress, search, constraint validation); pick them first when their behaviour and look meet the need: no install, no bundle, platform keyboard and screen-reader support.
setup_notes: Nothing to install. Works in every framework (JSX uses the same elements). Check each row's a11y_notes for newer features that need a fallback.
